hints.title: Set Conversion
hints.text: Convert nums1 and nums2 to sets for constant time membership checks.

hints.title: Count Overlaps
hints.text: ans1 is the count of elements in nums1 that appear in set(nums2), and ans2 is the count in nums2 that appear in set(nums1).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash set creation and linear membership filters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear searching without sets takes quadratic O(n * m).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use hash sets for O(1) membership lookups.
